Not really what you're asking for, but Barcelona/Catalonia was a locus for the anarchist CNT union in the Spanish Civil War, so there are films about that.

A few that come to mind:

Living Utopia (1997): Documentary about the CNT interviewing surviving veterans from the period
Libertarias (1996): Drama about La Mujeres Libres,  the women's section of the CNT
Land and Freedom (1995): about the POUM and mostly focused on the Aragon front, but Barcelona does play a key role

'Barcelona' (1994) is probably the film that best fits your description.

Outsite of that, there are some really great movies set in the city (Biutiful, Todo sobre mi madre, Land and Freedom) and even documentaries (Antonio Gaudi, En construcción), maybe those examples can help you too 

Escolta, molta sort amb el teu màster. I que vagi molt bé el viatge! 🙂
